hooks.command: bash -c 'FILE="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATHS"; case "$FILE" in *.dart) if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1; then dart format "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; else echo "dart format: skipped (not installed)"; fi ;; esac'

bash -c 'CMD="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_command"; case "$CMD" in *"git commit"*) if command -v dart >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f pubspec.yaml ]; then dart analyze --fatal-infos --fatal-warnings || { echo "dart analyze failed; commit blocked"; exit 1; }; else echo "dart: skipped (not installed or not a Flutter project)"; fi ;; esac'
